findings: A probe on SERVER_STARTED read StatusEffectClassification before Spell Engine's own SERVER_STARTED listener filled its movement-impairing set and reported Frozen and Roots as unclassified; the probe now runs on the first server tick.

Every raised-limit effect except rogues:demoralize (Shout) and rogues:shatter (Throw) is movement impairing or AI disabling, so Spell Engine's boss gate refuses it on #spell_engine:bosses regardless of the limit. Demoralize and Shatter are limited only by health; lampas-addons Q7 adds them to lampas:spell_crowd_control.
paladins:judgement is AI disabling (disables_mob_ai true), not movement impairing.
archers:entangling_roots is school spell_power:physical_melee; its power is the archer's attack damage, hence the flat health_base.
verification_limit: Covers the decoded registry entries, cooldowns under haste, underApplyLimit at the decided thresholds and the resource-manager bytes on a dedicated server with the seven jars and their dependency closure. Combat with a real player, the client-side registry decode and tooltips, full-pack behavior and Apotheosis elite/invader immunity (lampas-addons W6) are not covered.
